tip.simplebeacons.strong_upgrade: Off hand, axe or hammer: hit a beacon 8 times
simplebeacons.guide.page.1.title: Simple Beacons
simplebeacons.guide.page.1: The Strong Upgrade turns a beacon into a Strong Beacon with six pyramid levels and six more powers, and a conduit into a Strong Conduit with a 7x7x7 frame.
simplebeacons.guide.page.2.title: Strong Upgrade
simplebeacons.guide.page.2: A smithing template crafted from a nether star in the middle, four diamonds on the edges and four
simplebeacons.guide.page.3.title: Strong Upgrade
simplebeacons.guide.page.3: obsidian in the corners. It turns a beacon into a Strong Beacon and a conduit into a Strong Conduit.
simplebeacons.guide.page.4.title: Strong Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.4: A beacon with up to six pyramid levels: 11x11 and 13x13 below the Vanilla four (454 blocks in all). Range is 10 + 10 per
simplebeacons.guide.page.5.title: Strong Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.5: level (60 blocks at level 5, 70 at level 6), the effect lasts 9 + 2 per level seconds; it affects players only, like Vanilla.
simplebeacons.guide.page.6.title: Beacon screen
simplebeacons.guide.page.6: The Strong Beacon opens a beacon screen in Vanilla's own style, two rows taller: below Vanilla's rows a row for level 5 and one for level 6 with three powers each;
simplebeacons.guide.page.7.title: Beacon screen
simplebeacons.guide.page.7: the pyramid counter (for example Pyramid 6/6) and the current range and duration sit in the right field.
simplebeacons.guide.page.8.title: Upgrading a placed beacon or conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.8: Hold an axe (with a hammer mod such as
simplebeacons.guide.page.9.title: Upgrading a placed beacon or conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.9: Simple Hammers: its sledgehammer) in the main hand and the
simplebeacons.guide.page.10.title: Upgrading a placed beacon or conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.10: Strong Upgrade in the off hand, carry a nether star and use a placed beacon or conduit 8 times.
simplebeacons.guide.page.11.title: Strong Conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.11: A conduit that also accepts a 7x7x7 frame: three crossing 7x7 rings of prismarine, prismarine bricks, dark prismarine or sea
simplebeacons.guide.page.12.title: Strong Conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.12: lanterns (66 blocks). Range is (frame blocks / 7) x 16, up to 144 blocks with the full large frame.
simplebeacons.guide.page.13.title: Creative tabs
simplebeacons.guide.page.13: The module's items sit in its own creative tab and are also sorted into the fitting Vanilla tabs and the search tab.
simplebeacons.guide.page.14.title: Settings
simplebeacons.guide.page.14: More settings are in the mod's config screen.

quests.simplebeacons.start.welcome.descr: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple Beacons Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a prismarine shard.
